description: This file contains React hooks that facilitate creating stable references and memoized functions for state management and performance optimization in React functional components.

methods.name: createStableActions(actionsFactory, deps = [])
methods.description: Creates a memoized set of action functions to ensure their identities remain stable across renders, based on provided dependencies.

methods.name: useShallowMemo(value)
methods.description: Shallowly memoizes a value by comparing its keys and shallow equality, returning a stable reference if the value hasn't changed shallowly.

methods.name: useMemoSelector(selectorFactory, deps = [])
methods.description: Memoizes a selector function to derive data from state, ensuring a stable reference and avoiding unnecessary updates.

methods.name: bindActions(actionCreators, bindDeps = [])
methods.description: Generates a stable, memoized object containing bound action creators, maintaining their identities across renders.
